get.description: Returns the deterministic diff from `publicationId` to `otherPublicationId`. The diff is computed only from the two immutable publications and the entity/relationship versions they reference, and is materialised as a derived, disposable artefact on first request; repeated requests return the stored diff while it matches its publications. Both publications must belong to the same Knowledge Model.

get.summary: List known comparisons for a publication
get.description: Lists previously generated diffs in which the publication is either the source or the target, ordered by diff ID. Only comparison headers and summaries are returned; each is verified against a regeneration from its immutable publications, and a stored diff that no longer matches yields an integrity failure. Cursors are opaque and bound to the publication; a cursor issued for another publication is rejected with 400.

Classifies every entity and relationship version of one immutable publication as CURRENT, STALE or UNKNOWN by comparing the document versions recorded in its provenance with the catalogue's authoritative current-version pointer and revision. STALE takes precedence over UNKNOWN. Computed on demand and read-only; nothing is written, the filesystem is not consulted and timestamps or identifier order are never used as recency. Missing or inconsistent publication membership, snapshots, evidence, provenance, locators or historical document-version lineage yield an integrity failure, never UNKNOWN.

Lists currency records for the publication's entity and relationship versions, ordered by object type then stable ID using ordinal comparison. Each record carries its supporting-document results. A relationship's currency is derived only from its own supporting evidence and never from its endpoint entities. Cursors are opaque and bound to the publication, the filters, the last sort key and the currencyBasisHash; a malformed cursor or one issued for another publication or other filters is rejected with 400, and a cursor issued under a different catalogue basis is rejected with 409 so pages never mix catalogue states.
Returns a stored diff after verifying that regenerating it from its immutable publications yields identical content.

NotFound.description: Publication or object is absent from the selected publication

IntegrityFailure.description: Published membership, mandatory provenance or a stored diff is corrupt or inconsistent

CurrencyState.description: CURRENT: every supporting document version is still the authoritative current version. STALE: at least one supporting document has a different authoritative current version. UNKNOWN: lineage is valid but the current-version state cannot be resolved safely.

CurrencyReason.description: STALE reasons (derived only from stored content hashes): CONTENT_CHANGED, PROCESSING_CHANGED. UNKNOWN reasons: CURRENT_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE (document catalogued but no current version recorded), DOCUMENT_REMOVED (document no longer catalogued and no current version recorded), CURRENT_VERSION_UNRESOLVABLE (the recorded current version cannot be resolved to a version of the same catalogued document).

currencyBasisHash.description: SHA-256 over stable JSON of every supporting document's ID, document presence, current-version pointer ID, pointer revision, and the resolved pointer target's document ID and content hash (null when the target cannot be resolved). Unrelated catalogue documents are excluded.

catalogueRevision.description: Revision of the catalogue current-version pointer; null when no pointer is recorded.

reason.description: Null exactly when state is CURRENT.

PublicationCurrencyCursor.description: Opaque base64url encoding of a PublicationCurrencyCursorPayload.

PublicationCurrencyCursorPayload.description: Decoded cursor content, documented for transparency. Clients must treat cursors as opaque. objectType and state are present only when the corresponding filter was supplied.

ProjectedEntity.description: Publication-derived, disposable search projection of an immutable entity version snapshot

ProjectedRelationship.description: Publication-derived, disposable search projection of an immutable relationship version snapshot

SearchResults.description: Deterministically filtered, ID-ordered page of projection records (no scoring or ranking)

ChangeType.description: Observable change of one stable identity between two publications. ADDED: only in the target publication. REMOVED: only in the source publication. MODIFIED: in both with a different immutable version and a different content hash.

KnowledgeVersionReference.description: Immutable entity or relationship version on one side of a diff. `contentHash` is SHA-256 over the compared content fields of the version snapshot.

EntityChange.description: Descriptive fields come from the target version when present, otherwise from the source version. `from` is null for ADDED, `to` is null for REMOVED, and `changedFields` is empty unless MODIFIED.

RelationshipChange.description: Descriptive fields come from the target version when present, otherwise from the source version. `from` is null for ADDED, `to` is null for REMOVED, and `changedFields` is empty unless MODIFIED.

PublicationComparison.description: Header of a derived, disposable comparison between two immutable publications of one Knowledge Model.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the stable JSON of every diff field except `id`, `generatedAt` and `contentHash` itself; identical for identical publication pairs.

PublicationDiff.description: Derived, non-authoritative, rebuildable comparison of two immutable publications. Changes are ordered by stable entity or relationship ID; unchanged objects are counted in the summary but not listed.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the stable JSON of every diff field except `id`, `generatedAt` and `contentHash` itself; identical for identical publication pairs.
